value.rationale: The family comprises all unit-sphere lunes up to a hemisphere, a natural one-parameter class of spherical regions. Its squared-chord mean rises monotonically but its squared-chord variance has a surprising unique nondegenerate interior minimizer. The exact all-angle classification with sharp hemispherical maximum and explicit extremal equation adds geometric structure beyond elementary moment integration; this is a complete natural invariant optimization, not an arbitrary fixed-angle computation.
